context_for_next_testing_agent: CRM Refactor complete. New modules: 1) Leads with status (New, Contacted, Converted, Discarded) and source filters, 2) Clients simplified to Company/Individual types with display_name, 3) Contacts linked to clients, 4) Events with pipeline stages (Lead, Contacted, Proposal, Negotiation, Won, Lost), 5) Lead Forms with public endpoints for embeddable forms. Lead conversion creates Client + Contact + Event automatically. Pipeline Kanban view allows moving events between stages. Public lead forms accessible at /forms/{formId} without authentication.
